name: Mobile OTP login
query: Add login with mobile number and SMS code using Kavenegar.
expected_behavior: Step 2: Define an SMS provider interface and a Kavenegar implementation using pattern/lookup sending
Step 3: Generate codes with random_int(), hash them, expire in minutes, single use, capped attempts
Step 4: Rate-limit per mobile and per IP; same response for unknown numbers
Step 5: Log in with wp_set_auth_cookie() after verification
success_criteria: OTP is never stored in plain text
Persian digits in the code input are accepted
